description: Set or update a secret (an encrypted environment variable injected into the app). Encrypted at rest; only the running app process can read the plaintext. With store="secrets_manager" (needs a secrets provider on this AppCrane) the value goes to AWS Secrets Manager under this app and env's own path, and AppCrane keeps only the reference secretsmanager:<KEY>; do not call it more than once every 10 minutes per key. You can also set a reference directly as the value: secretsmanager:<NAME> or secretsmanager:<NAME>#<jsonField>, where NAME holds only letters, digits, _ and - and always resolves under this app and env, never an ARN or a path. A reference is resolved at every deploy and restart, and one that cannot be read fails that deploy or restart. Removing the env var, or the app, does not delete the AWS secret. Defaults to sandbox; require explicit stage="production" only when the user asks. App-admin or AppCrane admin only. Respects the caller's mcp_app_scope.

key.description: Env var name. Letters, digits, underscores; must not start with a digit.

store.description: Keep the value in AWS Secrets Manager instead of AppCrane's database. Omit for an ordinary encrypted env var.

value.description: The value to store (will be encrypted server-side).

name: appcrane_set_secret
